Two skiers of different weights wearing identical skis are sliding along a horizontal surface. Both come to rest as a result of the frictional force between the surface and the skis. The initial speed of both skiers is m s. What is true about the acceleration of the skiers and the frictional force that acts on the skis?

Acceleration

Frictional force
A. Equal Different
B. Different Equal
C. Equal Equal
D. Different Different
